full_text: Member Appeal or Grievance Form. Health Net Community Solutions (Health Net). Medi-Cal Member Appeal or Grievance Form English No. 914 4/7/2025. You can file an Appeal for a denied service or file a Grievance if you are not happy with the care received. Appeal filing window is 60 calendar days from the Notice of Action Letter. Submissions can be made by calling 1-800-675-6110, or mailing to Attn: Member Appeals and Grievance Department, PO Box 10348, Van Nuys, CA 91410-0348. Fax submissions to 1-877-831-6019. Under Senate Bill (SB) 923 Transgender, Gender Diverse or Intersex (TGI) Inclusive Care Act, members have a right to file a complaint for failure of plan staff to provide trans-inclusive care.
